title: ABT Tap — the TapId is composed of DeviceId, TID and UNIX timestamp
preface: This test is to confirm the audit TapId is the DeviceId, Terminal ID and UNIX timestamp concatenated.
preconds:
**GIVEN** an NIR GV head with DeviceId 042002 and Terminal ID 20115688 has accepted a tap
**AND** an example composed TapId of 042002201156881725545715

steps.content: **WHEN** the tap record is sent to the ABT back office
steps.expected: **THEN** the TapId is 042002201156881725545715 — DeviceId, Terminal ID and UNIX timestamp concatenated

expected:
The audit TapId concatenates DeviceId, Terminal ID and UNIX timestamp (042002 + 20115688 + 1725545715 = 042002201156881725545715).

[Automatable: Partial · Cross-check: CloudFare / MERIT]
citations: FBD-100658 para 226-231 (TapId field definition + worked example)
change_note: Fixed a real grounding error found on deep re-check: the precondition split the spec's own worked-example TapId string into the wrong DeviceId/TID boundary (case said DeviceId 0420 / TID 02201156; the spec's example is DeviceId 042002 / TID 20115688 -- concatenating 042002 + 20115688 + unix ts 1725545715 = 042002201156881725545715, which is what the case's own composed-TapId value already was). Also strengthened the weak expected line (flagged in the earlier coherence pass) to assert the concrete composed value rather than restate the title.

title: Barcode — a barcode on a mobile device screen validates the same as a printed one
preface: This test is to confirm a multi-use barcode shown on a mobile device screen validates identically to a printed barcode.
preconds:
**GIVEN** an NIR GV head is in service on a rail route
**AND** a valid Corethree mLink barcode (format 02) is shown on a passenger's mobile device screen

steps.content: **WHEN** the passenger presents the on-screen barcode to the reader
steps.expected:
**THEN** a green tick result is displayed
**AND** the gate opens

expected:
A Corethree mLink barcode presented from a mobile device screen validates using the same offline business rules as a printed Flowbird barcode.

[Automatable: Partial]
citations: FBD-100167 V12.00 para 267 (Corethree mLink mobile tickets validated by Flowbird devices offline, same business rules as TFTS Multiple Use barcodes)
change_note: Named the on-screen artefact as the Corethree mLink barcode (format 02) instead of an unnamed 'mobile device screen' barcode, closing the under-specification flagged in the earlier coherence pass (gv.findings.md).

title: Location Settings — a no-comms condition is indicated when changing location without back-office comms
preface: This test is to confirm the Location Settings screen behaves correctly when the GV has no back-office comms.
preconds: **GIVEN** a technician on the Location Settings screen with no comms to the back office

steps.content: **WHEN** the technician attempts to change the location
steps.expected: **THEN** a no-comms condition is indicated on the Location Settings screen

expected:
With no back-office comms the Location Settings screen indicates the no-comms condition. **UNCONFIRMED** whether the location edit/save is actually blocked or only flagged -- confirm on the live system.

[Automatable: Yes · Cross-check: CloudFare]
citations: FBD-100654 V1.02 (no paragraph found describing whether the edit is blocked vs merely flagged; not in the commissioning guide's Location Settings section, paras 249-253)
change_note: The old title asserted 'location cannot be changed' but the expected only ever proved a no-comms indication is shown -- a coherence gap flagged in the earlier pass. On deep re-check FBD-100654 does not state whether the change is actually blocked or just flagged, so the title now matches only what is tested/provable, and the unconfirmed blocking claim is marked explicitly rather than silently implied.
